areas.name: Bornholm
areas.notes: Tier 2I island, Bornholm. Held: island. bbox/center computed by the qualify run. Hold (dk-quality): island polygon is 15 clusters, not one hiking destination; re-scope into Almindingen, Roe Plantage, Hammeren, Paradisbakkerne, Dueodde. Batch B (dk-v3 replay, 2026-10-31): NEEDS-SOURCE-FIX (code): the one rescoped island area is almost clean. dk-v3 on rel 5176019 finds Rø Plantage Bornholm, Ringebakkerne, Døndal, Jons Kapel rundtur, Stenhuggerstien, Hammerknuden Rundt (Naturstyrelsen Nordbornholm guide https://naturstyrelsen.dk/find-et-naturomraade/naturguider/bornholm/nordbornholm/praktisk: five walks Salomons Sti, Hammerknuden Rundt, Stenhuggerstien, Cirkelstien, Finnens fodspor), Finnens fodspor, Pedersker Jagthus Rød and Gul, Sandflugtsstien, plus the 8 live Almindingen routes (excludable by id), 8 name-stitches (excludable by name) and TWO UNNAMED lwn relations at Blykobbe (r21053823, r21053824) that cannot be excluded because a curated exclusion must match a trail name. Cirkelstien, SPOR - Folkemødet and Den Grønne Ring are dropped by the relation-gap gate. Needs code (exclusion by id for unnamed relations, or an allowlist-only island mode). Intended display name: Bornholm uden Almindingen.

areas.name: Falster
areas.notes: Tier 2I island, Zealand. Held: island. bbox/center computed by the qualify run. Batch B (dk-v3 replay, 2026-10-31): ONE island destination for Falster instead of five small ones. 12 named routes: Horreby Lyng Lilla/Rød/Grøn/Hvid/Blå (VisitDenmark: several routes of 3 to 5 km over the only raised bog on Falster, https://www.visitdenmark.com/denmark/plan-your-trip/horreby-lyng-gdk1145973), Borremosen og Hannenov Skoven and Halskov Vænge (Naturstyrelsen guides Hannenov og Ovstrupskovene and Halskov Vænge og naturperler ved Falsters Østkyst), Bøtøskoven, Sporet ved Bønnet Slotsruin, Kroghage blå and grøn, Hasselø Natursti. Known omissions: the 4.5 km Hjertesti in Ovstrup Skov and the Hannenov walks beyond Borremosen (not in OSM), Gedser Odde (bird tower, no marked walk). Motionsslangen afstikker (spur of a 37 km exercise connector), the Naturlandet copy of the Bøtø loop and two name-stitches are excluded. Alternativ rute (a generic 10 mi Falster Rundt leg, r2776061) is dropped by the relation-gap gate on the Actions runner but kept by the local macOS replay (shapely/GEOS differs), so it is NOT in exclude_trails (a stale curated exclusion fails closed); it is a forbidden name in the proposed bless. Overlap: sibling entries horreby-lyng-dk, hannenov-skov-dk and boto-plantage-dk are held and must never be published next to this one. Rating: complete as far as OSM shows.
